title: Belt Buckle
description: While you have no potions, you have [blue]2[/blue] additional [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic applies +2 Dexterity whenever you have no potions in your inventory. The effect is dynamically added and removed as potions are obtained, discarded, or used, making its status context-dependent during combat.
